% Adapted from the TeX Live pgfmathfloat sci generic documentation.
\documentclass[border=2pt]{standalone}
\usepackage{pgfplotstable}
\begin{document}
\pgfplotstabletypeset[
  columns={sample,generic,unitless,aligned},
  columns/sample/.style={column name=Sample,string type},
  columns/generic/.style={
    column name=Generic,
    sci,sci zerofill,sci precision=2,
    sci generic={mantissa sep={\,\times\,},exponent={10^{#1}}}
  },
  columns/unitless/.style={
    column name=Unit mantissa false,
    sci,sci zerofill,sci precision=2,
    retain unit mantissa=false,
    sci generic={mantissa sep={\,\times\,},empty mantissa sep={},exponent={10^{#1}}}
  },
  columns/aligned/.style={
    column name=Generic align,
    sci,sci zerofill,sci precision=2,sci sep align,
    sci generic={mantissa sep={\,\times\,},exponent={10^{#1}}}
  }
]{
sample generic unitless aligned
A 0.001 0.001 0.001
B 123.4 123.4 123.4
C 1 1 1
D 0 0 0
E -0.001 -0.001 -0.001
}
\end{document}
